correctness.rationale: For the exactly specified twelve-dimensional Fourier-side affine representation over F_13, the cited 2021 Theorem 6.5 and equations (6.5),(6.10) reduce matrix recovery to character nonzeros and full rank of a 12x11 matrix. At <=3 active coordinates there are <=6 nonidentity ratios. Four active coordinates and rank 11 require >=11 nonzero rows, hence all 12 differences by parity, so a (13,4,1) perfect difference set. The exhaustive 55 normalized choices have precisely four patterns, each an affine image of {0,1,3,9}; the nine admissible translates have quotient counts (8,9,8,9,9,7,7,8,7), strictly under 11. For the exhibited five-point vector, character domination is 256-85=171 and the 11x11 exact minor is -2^43. Independently, a full 156x144 projector matrix has exact rank 144 after cyclotomic reduction to F_53, guaranteeing rank 144 over C. Standalone checker replayed and passed on actual packaged path. No claims for other primes.

value.rationale: The exact minimum Fourier support for full matrix recovery by a fixed affine group orbit is a natural resource invariant, not a renaming or arbitrary slice. At the first Singer four-point planar configuration (13,4,1), the obvious lower bound k(k-1)>=12 suggests four could suffice; the complete additive/multiplicative incompatibility forces five, and a concise explicit integer vector proves sharpness. This provides a reproducible structural counterexample to naive pair-count heuristics, with potential use in sparse structured orbit-sensing design. The claim is limited to p=13; no unsupported generalization is asserted.
